item.title: 4 Questions to Guide a Child's Heart - Dr. James Dobson Family Institute
item.description: It’s easy to focus solely on correcting our children’s behavior, but when we do, we risk missing the bigger picture: shepherding their hearts. This approach can lead to resentment, disconnection, and temporary fixes rather than lasting change. In this reel, Trina Alleyne shares four questions to ask your kids that can help you reach their hearts.

item.title: An Easter Message of Great Hope - Dr. James Dobson Family Institute
item.description: To those of you who are overwhelmed by the cares of life right now and are burdened by the weight of the world, I urge you to look to the risen Christ. He is our eternal hope! May His grace and peace surround you and your loved ones, not only on Easter Sunday, but every day of the year.

item.title: Discovering the Joy of Easter - Dr. James Dobson Family Institute
item.description: When I was a kid, Easter was all about the candy—and how much my siblings and I could consume before our parents pulled the plug on our holiday sugar fix. Of course, we dyed eggs in various pastel colors. And I looked forward to wearing a pretty new dress on Easter Sunday.

item.title: Prepare Your Family for Easter - Dr. James Dobson Family Institute
item.description: Easter is not just another holiday—it is the foundation of our faith. The death and resurrection of Jesus Christ changed everything. As parents, we have both the opportunity and the responsibility to prepare our hearts—and the hearts of our children—for what matters most.
